units.zh: 陳騫
units.en: Chen Qian
units.literal: Chen Qian

units.zh: 陳騫，臨淮東陽人也。
units.en: Chen Qian came from Dongyang in Linhuai commandery.
units.literal: Chen Qian was a man of Dongyang in Linhuai.

units.zh: 父矯，魏司徒。
units.en: His father, Chen Jiao, had served Wei as Minister of Education.
units.literal: His father was Chen Jiao, Minister of Education of Wei.

units.zh: 矯本廣陵劉氏，為外祖陳氏所養，因而改焉。
units.en: Though Jiao was born into the Liu family of Guangling, his mother's Chen relatives raised him, and he took their surname.
units.literal: Jiao had originally belonged to the Liu clan of Guangling; he was adopted and brought up by his maternal grandfather's Chen family, and therefore changed his surname.

units.zh: 騫沈厚有智謀。
units.en: Qian was reserved and thoughtful, with a gift for strategy.
units.literal: Qian was steady, deep, and resourceful.

units.zh: 初，矯為尚書令，侍中劉曄見幸于魏明帝，譖矯專權。
units.en: While Jiao headed the Department of State Affairs, Palace Attendant Liu Ye enjoyed Emperor Ming of Wei's favor and accused Jiao of wielding unchecked authority.
units.literal: At first, when Jiao was Director of the Department of State Affairs, the Palace Attendant Liu Ye, who was favored by Emperor Ming of Wei, slandered Jiao for monopolizing power.

units.zh: 矯憂懼，以問騫。
units.en: Alarmed, Jiao sought Qian's advice.
units.literal: Jiao was anxious and afraid, and asked Qian about it.

units.zh: 騫曰：「主上明聖，大人大臣，今若不合意，不過不作公耳。」
units.en: Qian replied, 'The sovereign is wise, and you stand among the great ministers. Even if you fall from favor, the worst that happens is that you are not enfeoffed as a duke.'
units.literal: Qian said, 'The lord is enlightened and sage; the great man is a chief minister. If you now fail to please him, at worst you will not be made a duke.'

units.zh: 後帝意果釋，騫尚少，為夏侯玄所侮，意色自若，玄以此異之。
units.en: The emperor's anger soon passed. Qian was still a youth when Xiahou Xuan slighted him; he never lost his composure, and Xuan came to respect him for it.
units.literal: Later the emperor's resentment indeed eased. Qian was still young when Xiahou Xuan humiliated him; his expression remained calm, and Xuan therefore thought him remarkable.

units.zh: 起家尚書郎，遷中山、安平太守，並著稱績。
units.en: He rose from Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat to governor of Zhongshan and Anping, distinguishing himself in both posts.
units.literal: He began his career as a Gentleman of the Palace Secretariat and was promoted to Governor of Zhongshan and of Anping; in both commands he earned praise for his administration.

units.zh: 徵為相國司馬、長史、禦吏中丞，遷尚書，封安國亭侯。
units.en: The court summoned him as Major to the Minister of State, Chief Clerk, and Palace Assistant Censor, then promoted him to Imperial Secretary and enfeoffed him as Marquis of An'guo Village.
units.literal: He was summoned to serve as Major to the Minister of State, Chief Clerk, and Palace Assistant Censor, then promoted to Shangshu and enfeoffed as Marquis of the An'guo village.

units.zh: 蜀賊寇隴右，以尚書持節行征蜀將軍，破賊而還。
units.en: During the Shu incursion into Longyou he led the expedition as acting general while holding his director's commission, routed the raiders, and withdrew.
units.literal: When Shu forces raided Longyou, he bore the staff of authority as Director of the Department of State Affairs and acted as general for the campaign against Shu; he defeated the enemy and returned.

units.zh: 會諸葛誕之亂，復以尚書行安東將軍。
units.en: During Zhuge Dan's revolt he took the same minister's commission and served as acting General of the East.
units.literal: When Zhuge Dan rebelled, he was again, as Director of the Department of State Affairs, appointed acting General of the East.

units.zh: 壽春平，拜使持節、都督淮北諸軍事、安東將軍，進爵廣陵侯。
units.en: When Shouchun fell, he received the credentials of area commander north of the Huai and kept his eastern generalship, with his title raised to Marquis of Guangling.
units.literal: After Shouchun was pacified, he was appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority, area commander for all military affairs north of the Huai, and General of the East; his noble rank was advanced to Marquis of Guangling.

units.zh: 轉都督豫州諸軍事、豫州刺史，持節、將軍如故。
units.en: He moved on to command Yuzhou's armies and govern the province, still bearing the staff and his general's rank.
units.literal: He was transferred to area commander for all military affairs in Yuzhou and Governor of Yuzhou, retaining the staff of authority and his general's title.

units.zh: 又轉都督江南諸軍事，徙都督荊州諸軍事、征南大將軍，封郯侯。
units.en: His command shifted to the southland, then to Jingzhou as General Who Conquers the South, with a marquisate at Tan.
units.literal: He was again made area commander south of the Yangzi, then transferred to area commander for Jingzhou and General Who Conquers the South, and enfeoffed as Marquis of Tan.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，以佐命之勳，進車騎將軍，封高平郡公，遷侍中、大將軍，出為都督揚州諸軍事，餘如故，假黃鉞。
units.en: After Sima Yan founded the Jin, Qian's founding service earned him the chariots-and-cavalry command, the ducal fief of Gaoping, posts as palace attendant and grand general, command of Yangzhou, and the ceremonial axe that marked supreme delegated authority.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, Qian was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry for his merit among the founding ministers, enfeoffed as Duke of Gaoping commandery, advanced to Palace Attendant and Grand General, and sent out as area commander for Yangzhou's armies, his other posts unchanged; he was also granted the yellow battle-axe.

units.zh: 攻拔吳枳裏城，破塗中屯戍。
units.en: He seized Wu's Zhili fortress and dismantled the encampment at Tuzhong.
units.literal: He stormed and took the Wu stronghold at Zhili and destroyed the garrison at Tuzhong.

units.zh: 賜騫兄子惺爵關中侯。
units.en: An imperial grant raised Qian's nephew Xing to Marquis of Guanzhong.
units.literal: The emperor bestowed the noble rank of Marquis of Guanzhong on Qian's nephew Xing.

units.zh: 咸甯初，遷太尉，轉大司馬。
units.en: At the opening of the Xianning reign he became Grand Commandant, then Grand Marshal.
units.literal: In the early Xianning era he was promoted to Grand Commandant, then to Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 騫因入朝，言於帝曰：「胡烈、牽弘皆勇而無謀，強于自用，非綏邊之材，將為國恥。
units.en: Qian then entered court and said to the emperor, "Hu Lie and Qian Hong are both brave but without strategy and are forceful in following their own judgment. They are not men fit to pacify the frontier and will become a disgrace to the state.
units.literal: Qian then entered court and said to the emperor, "Hu Lie and Qian Hong are both brave but without strategy and are forceful in following their own judgment. They are not men fit to pacify the frontier and will become a disgrace to the state.

units.zh: 願陛下詳之。」
units.en: I hope Your Majesty will examine this carefully."
units.literal: I hope Your Majesty will examine this carefully."

units.zh: 時弘為揚州刺史，不承順騫命。
units.en: Hong was then governor of Yangzhou and would not follow Qian's directives.
units.literal: At the time Qian Hong was Governor of Yangzhou and refused to obey Qian's orders.

units.zh: 帝以為不協相構，於是征弘，既至，尋復以為涼州刺史。
units.en: The ruler took their clash for mutual spite, recalled Hong, then almost immediately sent him west as governor of Liangzhou once more.
units.literal: The emperor assumed the two men were feuding and slandering each other, so he summoned Hong; after Hong arrived he soon appointed him Governor of Liangzhou again.

units.zh: 騫竊歎息，以為必敗。
units.en: Qian privately groaned, certain the policy would end badly.
units.literal: Qian sighed to himself, convinced disaster would follow.

units.zh: 二人後果失羌戎之和，皆被寇喪沒，征討連歲，僅而得定，帝乃悔之。
units.en: Both later shattered tribal alliances, fell to raids, and cost years of campaigning before the frontier steadied—only then did the court regret ignoring Qian.
units.literal: The two men afterward alienated the Qiang and Rong peoples; both died under barbarian attack, and campaigns dragged on for years before order was barely restored. The emperor then regretted his decision.

units.zh: 騫少有度量，含垢匿瑕，所在有績。
units.en: From boyhood Qian bore slights lightly and governed effectively wherever he was posted.
units.literal: Qian had possessed forbearance since youth; he swallowed insults and overlooked faults, and wherever he served he left a record of achievement.

units.zh: 與賈充、石苞、裴秀等俱為心膂，而騫智度過之，充等亦自以為不及也。
units.en: He stood with Jia Chong, Shi Bao, and Pei Xiu among the sovereign's closest advisers, but his political judgment exceeded theirs, as they themselves allowed.
units.literal: Together with Jia Chong, Shi Bao, Pei Xiu, and others he belonged to the emperor's inner circle, yet Qian's judgment surpassed theirs, and they conceded they could not match him.

units.zh: 累處方任，為士庶所懷。
units.en: Repeated tours as a regional commander won him the confidence of scholar and commoner alike.
units.literal: Time and again he held regional authority, and both elites and commoners looked to him with trust.

units.zh: 既位極人臣，年逾致仕，思欲退身，
units.en: At the summit of a minister's career and past the usual age of retirement, he longed to withdraw.
units.literal: Once he had climbed to a subject's highest rank and passed the age for retirement, he wished to step down.

units.zh: 咸寧三年，求入朝，因乞骸骨。
units.en: In the third year of Xianning, he sought permission to return to Luoyang and yield his office, pleading age and infirmity.
units.literal: In the third year of Xianning, he asked leave to come to the capital and petitioned to retire on grounds of old age.

units.zh: 賜袞冕之服，詔曰：「騫元勳舊德，統乂東夏，方弘遠績，以一吳會，而所苦未除，每表懇切，重勞以方事。
units.en: He was granted the robe with gun-dragon and coronet, and the edict said, "Qian has old virtue and founding merit, governs and orders the eastern Xia, and is about to broaden distant achievements by unifying Wu and Kuaiji. But his affliction has not been removed, and whenever he memorializes earnestly, we again burden him with current affairs.
units.literal: He was granted the robe with gun-dragon and coronet, and the edict said, "Qian has old virtue and founding merit, governs and orders the eastern Xia, and is about to broaden distant achievements by unifying Wu and Kuaiji. But his affliction has not been removed, and whenever he memorializes earnestly, we again burden him with current affairs.

units.zh: 今聽留京城，以前太尉府為大司馬府，增置祭酒二人，帳下司馬、官騎、大車、鼓吹皆如前，親兵百人，廚田十頃，廚園五十畝，廚士十人，器物經用皆留給焉。
units.en: Now he is permitted to remain in the capital. The former Grand Commandant's office is to be made the Grand Marshal's office; two Libationers are to be added, and his tent staff, office cavalry, great carriages, and drums and pipes are all to be as before. A hundred personal troops, ten qing of kitchen fields, fifty mu of kitchen gardens, ten kitchen workers, and vessels and regular expenses are all to remain supplied to him.
units.literal: Now he is permitted to remain in the capital. The former Grand Commandant's office is to be made the Grand Marshal's office; two Libationers are to be added, and his tent staff, office cavalry, great carriages, and drums and pipes are all to be as before. A hundred personal troops, ten qing of kitchen fields, fifty mu of kitchen gardens, ten kitchen workers, and vessels and regular expenses are all to remain supplied to him.

units.zh: 又給乘輿輦，出入殿中加鼓吹，如漢蕭何故事。」
units.en: He is also to be given the imperial carriage litter, and when entering and leaving the palace halls he is to have drums and pipes added, following the precedent of Xiao He under the Han."
units.literal: He is also to be given the imperial carriage litter, and when entering and leaving the palace halls he is to have drums and pipes added, following the precedent of Xiao He under the Han."

units.zh: 騫累稱疾辭位，詔曰：「騫履德論道，朕所諮詢。
units.en: Qian repeatedly claimed illness and declined his position. The edict said, "Qian practices virtue and discusses the Way; he is someone whom I consult.
units.literal: Qian repeatedly claimed illness and declined his position. The edict said, "Qian practices virtue and discusses the Way; he is someone whom I consult.

units.zh: 方賴謀猷，以弘庶績，宜時視事。
units.en: I am just now relying on his plans and counsels in order to broaden the many achievements, and he should attend to affairs at the proper time.
units.literal: I am just now relying on his plans and counsels in order to broaden the many achievements, and he should attend to affairs at the proper time.

units.zh: 可遣散騎常侍諭意。」
units.en: A Cavalier Regular Attendant may be sent to explain my intent."
units.literal: A Cavalier Regular Attendant may be sent to explain my intent."

units.zh: 騫輒歸第，詔又遣侍中敦諭還府。
units.en: Instead Qian retired to his house, prompting another round of messages from attendants pressing him to reopen his offices.
units.literal: Qian went straight home, and the court again sent a Palace Attendant to urge him sternly to return to headquarters.

units.zh: 遂固請，許之，位同保傅，在三司之上，賜以几杖，不朝，安車駟馬，以高平公還第。
units.en: At last his resignation stood: he was ranked above the three highest ministers like an imperial mentor, with chair, staff, freedom from court audience, a coach and four, and the title of Duke of Gaoping while living privately.
units.literal: He pressed his request until it was granted. His rank equaled that of the elder tutors, standing above the Three Dukes; he received a seat and staff, was excused from court, given a comfortable carriage and four-horse team, and sent to his estate as Duke of Gaoping.

units.zh: 帝以其勳舊耆老，禮之甚重。
units.en: As a dynastic founder now grown old, Qian received extraordinary deference from the throne.
units.literal: The emperor, honoring him as a founding elder, treated him with exceptional ceremony.

units.zh: 又以騫有疾，聽乘輿上殿。
units.en: Ill health won him the privilege of a litter right up to the audience hall.
units.literal: Because Qian was unwell, he was permitted to be carried in a litter into the hall.

units.zh: 騫素無謇諤之風，然與帝語傲；
units.en: He was not known for blunt remonstrance, but he spoke to the sovereign with something like insolence,
units.literal: Qian had never been outspoken, yet in speaking with the emperor he carried himself with pride;

units.zh: 及見皇太子加敬，時人以為諂。
units.en: yet before the heir apparent he became deferential, which contemporaries dismissed as sycophancy.
units.literal: when he met the crown prince he showed deference, and people of the day took it for flattery.

units.zh: 弟稚與其子輿忿爭，遂說騫子女穢行，騫表徙弟，以此獲譏於世。
units.en: When his younger brother Zhi quarreled with Qian's son Yu, Zhi then spread scandal about the misconduct of Qian's children; Qian memorialized to have his brother banished, and was ridiculed for it.
units.literal: His younger brother Zhi quarreled with Qian's son Yu, then spread scandal about the misconduct of Qian's children; Qian memorialized to have his brother banished, and the world ridiculed him for it.

units.zh: 元康二年薨，年八十一，加以袞斂，贈太傅，諡曰武。
units.en: In the second year of Yuankang, he died at eighty-one, laid out in princely robes, ennobled posthumously as Grand Tutor with the epithet "Martial."
units.literal: In the second year of Yuankang, he died at eighty-one. He was buried in ducal vestments, posthumously honored as Grand Tutor, with the posthumous name Martial.

units.zh: 及葬，帝于大司馬門臨喪，望柩流涕，禮依大司馬石苞故事。
units.en: The sovereign mourned him at the Grand Marshal Gate, weeping over the bier as had been done for Grand Marshal Shi Bao.
units.literal: At the burial the emperor came to the Grand Marshal Gate to mourn, gazed at the coffin and wept; the rites followed the precedent for Grand Marshal Shi Bao.

units.zh: 子輿嗣爵。=
units.en: The noble title passed to his son Yu.
units.literal: His son Yu inherited the noble title.

units.zh: 子輿
units.en: Yu
units.literal: Yu

units.zh: =輿字顯初，拜散騎侍郎、洛陽令，遷黃門侍郎，厲將校左軍、大司農、侍中。
units.en: Yu, courtesy name Xianchu, was appointed Cavalier Gentleman-in-Attendance and Magistrate of Luoyang, promoted to Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, then served successively as colonel of the Left Army, Minister of Agriculture, and Palace Attendant.
units.literal: Yu, courtesy name Xianchu, was appointed Supernumerary Gentleman of the Palace and Magistrate of Luoyang, promoted to Palace Attendant, and served successively as colonel of the left among the household guards, Minister of Agriculture, and Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 坐與叔父不睦，出為河內太守。
units.en: A bitter break with his uncle cost him the capital and landed him in Henei as governor.
units.literal: Because he could not live peaceably with his uncle, he was sent out as Governor of Henei.

units.zh: 輿雖無檢正，而有力致。
units.en: He was no model of propriety, but he wielded real power.
units.literal: Yu lacked strict rectitude, yet he possessed force and influence.

units.zh: 尋卒，子植字弘先嗣，官至散騎常侍。
units.en: He died soon after; his heir Zhi (Hongxian) reached the post of supernumerary attendant.
units.literal: He died not long afterward; his son Zhi, courtesy name Hongxian, succeeded him and rose to Supernumerary Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 卒，子粹嗣，永嘉中遇害，孝武帝以騫玄孫襲爵。
units.en: The line ran Zhi to Cui until Yongjia partisans murdered Cui; Emperor Xiaowu then restored the title through a great-grandson of Qian.
units.literal: When Zhi died, his son Cui succeeded; in the Yongjia turmoil Cui was killed, and Emperor Xiaowu had Qian's great-grandson inherit the title.

units.zh: 卒，弟子浩之嗣。
units.en: When this successor died, cousin Haozhi inherited the fief.
units.literal: When that heir died, his cousin Haozhi succeeded.

units.zh: 宋受禪，國除。
units.en: The Song founder's usurpation ended the house's noble title.
units.literal: When Song accepted the abdication, the fief was abolished.

units.zh: 裴秀
units.en: Pei Xiu
units.literal: Pei Xiu

units.zh: 裴秀，字季彥，河東聞喜人也。
units.en: Pei Xiu, style Jiyan, hailed from Wenxi county in Hedong.
units.literal: Pei Xiu, courtesy name Jiyan, was a man of Wenxi in Hedong.

units.zh: 祖茂，漢尚書令。
units.en: His grandfather Mao once directed the Han Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: His grandfather Mao had been Director of the Department of State Affairs under the Han.

units.zh: 父潛，魏尚書令。
units.en: His father Qian held the same office under Wei.
units.literal: His father Qian had been Director of the Department of State Affairs under Wei.

units.zh: 秀少好學，有風操，八歲能屬文。
units.en: He was bookish and principled even as a boy, composing polished prose at eight.
units.literal: Xiu loved learning from youth and cultivated integrity; at eight sui he could compose essays.

units.zh: 叔父徽有盛名，賓客甚眾。
units.en: Uncle Wei attracted crowds of distinguished visitors.
units.literal: His uncle Wei enjoyed great fame, and guests thronged his house.

units.zh: 秀年十餘歲，有詣徽者，出則過秀。
units.en: Before he was eleven, departing guests routinely paid their respects to young Xiu.
units.literal: When Xiu was little more than ten, callers who visited Wei would stop to see Xiu on their way out.

units.zh: 然秀母賤，嫡母宣氏不之禮，嘗使進饌於客，見者皆為之起。
units.en: Because Xiu's mother was a concubine of humble origin, Lady Xuan snubbed her and once made her wait on guests—yet visitors rose to honor the boy she bore.
units.literal: Yet Xiu's mother was of low birth, and his father's principal wife, Lady Xuan, treated her coldly; she once sent her to serve food to guests, and everyone who saw it rose in respect.

units.zh: 秀母曰：「微賤如此，當應為小兒故也。」
units.en: Xiu's mother said, "With lowliness like this, it must be because of the child."
units.literal: Xiu's mother said, "With lowliness like this, it must be because of the child."

units.zh: 宣氏知之，後遂止。
units.en: Once Lady Xuan grasped the point, the abuse stopped.
units.literal: When Lady Xuan understood, she ceased.

units.zh: 時人為之語曰：「後進領袖有裴秀。」
units.en: People of the time made a saying about him: "Among the leaders of those who came later, there is Pei Xiu."
units.literal: People of the time made a saying about him: "Among the leaders of those who came later, there is Pei Xiu."

units.zh: 渡遼將軍毌丘儉嘗薦秀于大將軍曹爽，曰：「生而岐嶷，長蹈自然，玄靜守真，性入道奧；
units.en: General Who Crosses the Liao, Guanqiu Jian, once recommended Xiu to Great General Cao Shuang, saying, "Born extraordinary and lofty, growing up he trod what was natural, was profound and still, guarded truth, and by nature entered the depths of the Way.
units.literal: General Who Crosses the Liao Guanqiu Jian once recommended Xiu to Great General Cao Shuang, saying, "Born extraordinary and lofty, growing up he trod what was natural, was profound and still, guarded truth, and by nature entered the depths of the Way.

units.zh: 博學強記，無文不該；
units.en: He is broadly learned and strong in memory, and there is no writing he does not encompass.
units.literal: He is broadly learned and strong in memory, and there is no writing he does not encompass.

units.zh: 孝友著于鄉党，高聲聞於遠近。
units.en: His filial piety and friendship are manifest in his village, and his high reputation is heard near and far.
units.literal: His filial piety and friendship are manifest in his village, and his high reputation is heard near and far.

units.zh: 誠宜弼佐謨明，助和鼎味，毗贊大府，光昭盛化。
units.en: Truly he should assist bright plans, help harmonize the flavor of the tripod, aid and support the great office, and make flourishing transformation shine.
units.literal: Truly he should assist bright plans, help harmonize the flavor of the tripod, aid and support the great office, and make flourishing transformation shine.

units.zh: 非徒子奇、甘羅之儔，兼包顏、冉、游、夏之美。」
units.en: He is not merely of the class of Ziqi and Gan Luo, but also contains the virtues of Yan, Ran, You, and Xia."
units.literal: He is not merely of the class of Ziqi and Gan Luo, but also contains the virtues of Yan, Ran, You, and Xia."

units.zh: 爽乃辟為掾，襲父爵清陽亭侯，遷黃門侍郎。
units.en: Shuang therefore summoned him as an aide; Xiu inherited his father's Qingyang village marquisate and was promoted to Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
units.literal: Shuang therefore summoned him as an aide; Xiu inherited his father's Qingyang village marquisate and was promoted to Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.

units.zh: 爽誅，以故吏免。
units.en: Shuang's fall stripped Xiu of rank as an affiliated official.
units.literal: When Shuang was executed, Xiu lost office as a former subordinate.

units.zh: 頃之，為廷尉正，曆文帝安東及衛將軍司馬，軍國之政，多見信納。
units.en: He soon judged cases at court, then advised Sima Zhao as army major through the eastern and household commands, shaping both strategy and administration.
units.literal: Soon afterward he became Director of Justice of the Court of Trials and successively Major under Emperor Wen's General of the East and General of the Guard; military and civil plans often followed his advice.

units.zh: 遷散騎常侍。
units.en: He advanced to supernumerary palace attendant.
units.literal: He was promoted to Supernumerary Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 帝之討諸葛誕也，秀與尚書僕射陳泰、黃門侍郎鍾會以行台從，豫參謀略。
units.en: During the Zhuge Dan campaign he rode with Chen Tai and Zhong Hui on the field headquarters staff, shaping operational plans.
units.literal: When the emperor campaigned against Zhuge Dan, Xiu accompanied Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat Chen Tai and Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Zhong Hui with the mobile headquarters staff and took part in strategic planning.

units.zh: 及誕平，轉尚書，進封魯陽鄉侯，增邑千戶。
units.en: Dan's defeat brought him the ministry, a Luyang district marquisate, and a thousand extra households.
units.literal: When Dan was suppressed, Xiu was transferred to be a Shangshu, advanced to Marquis of the Luyang district, with an additional thousand households.

units.zh: 常道鄉公立，以豫議定策，進爵縣侯，增邑七百戶，遷尚書僕射。
units.en: He helped seat the Duke of Changdao and earned a county marquisate, seven hundred added households, and the ministry of the left.
units.literal: When the Duke of Changdao was enthroned, Xiu shared in the preliminary council that fixed the succession; he was advanced to county marquis with seven hundred more households and promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

units.zh: 魏咸熙初，厘革憲司。
units.en: Wei reform reached the legal organs in the first Xianxi years.
units.literal: In the early Wei Xianxi era the statutory offices were overhauled.

units.zh: 時荀顗定禮儀，賈充正法律，而秀改官制焉。
units.en: While Xun Yi handled rites and Jia Chong the code, Xiu rewrote the bureaucracy.
units.literal: Xun Yi fixed ritual; Jia Chong corrected statutes; Xiu redesigned official ranks.

units.zh: 秀議五等之爵，自騎督已上六百餘人皆封。
units.en: His scheme of five noble grades ennobled over six hundred officers from cavalry commander up.
units.literal: Xiu proposed the five ranks of nobility; more than six hundred men from Cavalry Commander upward received fiefs.

units.zh: 於是秀封濟川侯，地方六十里，邑千四百戶，以高苑縣濟川墟為侯國。
units.en: He himself became marquis of Jichuan—sixty square li and fourteen hundred households centered on the Gaoyuan canton.
units.literal: Thereupon Xiu was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jichuan, with a territory sixty li square and 1,400 households, making the Jichuan canton of Gaoyuan county his marquisate.

units.zh: 初，文帝未定嗣，而屬意舞陽侯攸。
units.en: When Sima Zhao still hesitated over the succession, his eye rested on the Marquis of Wuyang, You.
units.literal: At first Emperor Wen had not settled on an heir and favored the Marquis of Wuyang, Sima You.

units.zh: 武帝懼不得立，問秀曰：「人有相否？」
units.en: Emperor Wu feared he would not be established and asked Xiu, "Do people have physiognomic signs or not?"
units.literal: Emperor Wu feared he would not be established and asked Xiu, "Do people have physiognomic signs or not?"

units.zh: 因以奇表示之。
units.en: He unveiled his own striking features for Xiu to read.
units.literal: He then displayed his extraordinary appearance.

units.zh: 秀後言于文帝曰：「中撫軍人望既茂，天表如此，固非人臣之相也。」
units.en: Xiu later said to Emperor Wen, "The Central Pacification Army already has flourishing public hopes, and his heavenly appearance is like this; it certainly is not the appearance of a subject."
units.literal: Xiu later said to Emperor Wen, "The Central Pacification Army already has flourishing public hopes, and his heavenly appearance is like this; it certainly is not the appearance of a subject."

units.zh: 由是世子乃定。
units.en: Thereby the heir-apparent was settled.
units.literal: Thereby the heir-apparent was settled.

units.zh: 武帝既即王位，拜尚書令、右光祿大夫，與御史大夫王沈、衛將軍賈充俱開府，加給事中。
units.en: After Emperor Wu had taken the position of king, he appointed Pei Xiu Secretariat Director and Right Guanglu Grandee. Together with Censor-in-chief Wang Shen and General Who Guards Jia Chong, Pei Xiu opened an office, and he was additionally made Given Attendance within the Palace.
units.literal: After Emperor Wu had taken the position of king, he appointed Pei Xiu Secretariat Director and Right Guanglu Grandee. Together with Censor-in-chief Wang Shen and General Who Guards Jia Chong, Pei Xiu opened an office, and he was additionally made Given Attendance within the Palace.

units.zh: 及帝受禪，加左光祿大夫，封钜鹿郡公，邑三千戶。
units.en: At the Jin founding Xiu gained the left household grandee, the Julu ducal fief, and three thousand households.
units.literal: When he received the abdication, Xiu added the title Left Imperial Household Grandee and was enfeoffed as Duke of Julu commandery with three thousand households.

units.zh: 時安遠護軍郝詡與故人書云：「與尚書令裴秀相知，望其為益。」
units.en: At the time, Protector of the Army Who Pacifies Distant Places Hao Xu wrote to an old friend, "I am acquainted with Secretariat Director Pei Xiu and hope he will be of benefit."
units.literal: At the time, Protector of the Army Who Pacifies Distant Places Hao Xu wrote to an old friend, "I am acquainted with Secretariat Director Pei Xiu and hope he will be of benefit."

units.zh: 有司奏免秀官，詔曰：「不能使人之不加諸我，此古人所難。
units.en: The responsible offices memorialized to dismiss Xiu from office, but the edict said, "Being unable to make others not add things to me is what even the ancients found difficult.
units.literal: The responsible offices memorialized to dismiss Xiu from office, but the edict said, "Being unable to make others not add things to me is what even the ancients found difficult.

units.zh: 交關人事，詡之罪耳，豈尚書令能防乎！
units.en: Making connections over personnel affairs is Xu's crime; how could the Secretariat Director have prevented it?
units.literal: Making connections over personnel affairs is Xu's crime; how could the Secretariat Director have prevented it?

units.zh: 其勿有所問。」
units.en: Let there be no inquiry into this."
units.literal: Let there be no inquiry into this."

units.zh: 司隸校尉李憙復上言，騎都尉劉尚為尚書令裴秀占官稻田，求禁止秀。
units.en: Li Xi then accused Liu Shang of grabbing state grain fields for Pei and demanded Pei's house arrest.
units.literal: The Colonel Director of Retainers Li Xi submitted again: Commandant of Cavalry Liu Shang had seized official rice paddies on behalf of Minister Pei Xiu, and he asked that Xiu be restricted.

units.zh: 詔又以秀幹翼朝政，有勳績於王室，不可以小疵掩大德，使推正尚罪而解秀禁止焉。
units.en: The emperor refused: Pei's stewardship outweighed petty corruption; punish Shang instead and release Pei.
units.literal: Another edict answered that Xiu upheld the government and had served the royal house with merit; small faults must not eclipse great virtue—have Shang prosecuted and lift Xiu's restriction.

units.zh: 久之，詔曰：「夫三司之任，以翼宣皇極，弼成王事者也。
units.en: After a long while, an edict said, "The responsibility of the Three Excellencies is to assist and proclaim the imperial standard and help complete the kingly affairs.
units.literal: After a long while, an edict said, "The responsibility of the Three Excellencies is to assist and proclaim the imperial standard and help complete the kingly affairs.

units.zh: 故經國論道，賴之明喆，苟非其人，官不虛備。
units.en: Good government requires worthy occupants; hollow titles dishonor the dynasty.
units.literal: Therefore ordering the realm and debating the Way depends on enlightened men; ill-suited officers must not fill honored posts in vain.

units.zh: 尚書令、左光祿大夫裴秀，雅量弘博，思心通遠，先帝登庸，贊事前朝。
units.en: It singled out Pei—minister of state and left household grandee—for wisdom cultivated under the previous reign.
units.literal: Director of the Department of State Affairs and Left Imperial Household Grandee Pei Xiu combines generous breadth with searching thought; the late emperor raised him to advance the former court.

units.zh: 朕受明命，光佐大業，勳德茂著，配蹤元凱。
units.en: The new emperor hailed Pei's aid as matching the deeds of the Yuan and Kai worthies.
units.literal: I have received the luminous mandate; he brilliantly assists the great enterprise; merit and virtue flourish and match the deeds of Yuan and Kai.

units.zh: 宜正位居體，以康庶績。
units.en: He should assume the fitting office and embody his role so that every branch of government thrives.
units.literal: He ought to occupy the proper station and conform his person so as to bring tranquility to the manifold tasks.

units.zh: 其以秀為司空。」
units.en: Appoint Pei Xiu Minister of Works."
units.literal: Let Pei Xiu be appointed Minister of Works."

units.zh: 秀儒學洽聞，且留心政事，當禪代之際，總納言之要，其所裁當，禮無違者。
units.en: Trained in the classics and widely read, Xiu focused on administration; at the dynastic handover he controlled the channels of counsel, and his rulings never violated prescribed ritual.
units.literal: Xiu was steeped in Confucian learning and broadly informed, and he attended closely to government; during the abdication transition he held the portfolio that gathers memorials and voices policy, and whatever he ruled on matched ritual without breach.

units.zh: 又以職在地官，以《禹貢》山川地名，從來久遠，多有變易。
units.en: His duties under the earth ministry also concerned the "Tribute of Yu," whose topography had shifted across centuries.
units.literal: Moreover, because his portfolio belonged to the Ministry of Earth, the mountains, rivers, and place names recorded in the "Tribute of Yu" had, across long ages, undergone many alterations.

units.zh: 後世說者或強牽引，漸以暗昧。
units.en: Later exegetes often forced contrived readings, obscuring the original geography.
units.literal: Later commentators sometimes forced strained glosses, and understanding grew murky.

units.zh: 於是甄摘舊文，疑者則闕，古有名而今無者，皆隨事注列，作《禹貢地域圖》十八篇，奏之，藏于秘府。
units.en: He sifted the classical text, omitted uncertain points, glossed every obsolete toponym, and submitted his eighteen-scroll "Yugong" atlas to the palace library.
units.literal: Thereupon he culled the old text, leaving blanks wherever doubtful; wherever an ancient name survived but no modern one existed, he annotated each case in order, composed the eighteen-scroll "Regional Map of the Tribute of Yu," presented it, and deposited it in the secret archive.

units.zh: 其序曰：
units.en: The preface begins:
units.literal: Its preface states:

units.zh: 圖書之設，由來尚矣。
units.en: The establishment of maps and documents has a very ancient origin.
units.literal: The establishment of maps and documents has a very ancient origin.

units.zh: 自古立象垂制，而賴其用。
units.en: From antiquity, setting up images and handing down institutions depended on their use.
units.literal: From antiquity, setting up images and handing down institutions depended on their use.

units.zh: 三代置其官，國史掌厥職。
units.en: The Three Dynasties established the relevant office, and the state historians managed its duties.
units.literal: The Three Dynasties established the relevant office, and the state historians managed its duties.

units.zh: 暨漢屠咸陽，丞相蕭何盡收秦之圖籍。
units.en: When the Han slaughtered Xianyang, Chancellor Xiao He collected all the maps and registers of Qin.
units.literal: When the Han slaughtered Xianyang, Chancellor Xiao He collected all the maps and registers of Qin.

units.zh: 今秘書既無古之地圖，又無蕭何所得，惟有漢氏《輿地》及《括地》諸雜圖。
units.en: Now the Imperial Library has neither the maps of antiquity nor what Xiao He obtained, but only the miscellaneous Han maps such as Yudi and Kuodi.
units.literal: Now the Imperial Library has neither the maps of antiquity nor what Xiao He obtained, but only the miscellaneous Han maps such as Yudi and Kuodi.

units.zh: 各不設分率，又不考正准望，亦不備載名山大川。
units.en: None of them establishes scale ratios, nor do they examine and correct orientation and sighting; they also do not fully record famous mountains and great rivers.
units.literal: None of them establishes scale ratios, nor do they examine and correct orientation and sighting; they also do not fully record famous mountains and great rivers.

units.zh: 雖有粗形，皆不精審，不可依據。
units.en: Although they have rough forms, none is precise and examined, and they cannot be relied on.
units.literal: Although they have rough forms, none is precise and examined, and they cannot be relied on.

units.zh: 或荒外迂誕之言，不合事實，於義無取。
units.en: Some contain roundabout and absurd statements from beyond the wilds, do not accord with actual facts, and have no value in meaning.
units.literal: Some contain roundabout and absurd statements from beyond the wilds, do not accord with actual facts, and have no value in meaning.

units.zh: 大晉龍興，混一六合，以清宇宙，始於庸蜀，冞入其岨。
units.en: When the Great Jin rose like a dragon, unified the six directions, and cleared the universe, it began with Yong and Shu and went deeply into their rugged terrain.
units.literal: When the Great Jin rose like a dragon, unified the six directions, and cleared the universe, it began with Yong and Shu and went deeply into their rugged terrain.

units.zh: 文皇帝乃命有司，撰訪吳蜀地圖。
units.en: Emperor Wen then ordered the responsible offices to compile and seek out maps of Wu and Shu.
units.literal: Emperor Wen then ordered the responsible offices to compile and seek out maps of Wu and Shu.

units.zh: 蜀土既定，六軍所經，地域遠近，山川險易，征路迂直，校驗圖記，罔或有差。
units.en: After the lands of Shu were settled, the distances of the regions, the danger or ease of mountains and rivers, and the bends or straights of campaign routes traversed by the Six Armies were checked against maps and records, and there was no discrepancy.
units.literal: After the lands of Shu were settled, the distances of the regions, the danger or ease of mountains and rivers, and the bends or straights of campaign routes traversed by the Six Armies were checked against maps and records, and there was no discrepancy.

units.zh: 今上考《禹貢》山海川流，原隰陂澤，古之九州，及今之十六州，郡國縣邑，疆界鄉陬，及古國盟會舊名，水陸徑路，為地圖十八篇。
units.en: Now, by examining above the mountains, seas, streams, plains, wetlands, embankments, and marshes of the Tribute of Yu, the ancient Nine Provinces, the present sixteen provinces, commanderies, kingdoms, counties, cities, borders, villages, corners, old names of ancient states and covenant sites, and water and land routes, I have made eighteen fascicles of maps.
units.literal: Now, by examining above the mountains, seas, streams, plains, wetlands, embankments, and marshes of the Tribute of Yu, the ancient Nine Provinces, the present sixteen provinces, commanderies, kingdoms, counties, cities, borders, villages, corners, old names of ancient states and covenant sites, and water and land routes, I have made eighteen fascicles of maps.

units.zh: 製圖之體有六焉。
units.en: The essentials for making maps are six.
units.literal: The essentials for making maps are six.

units.zh: 一曰分率，所以辨廣輪之度也。
units.en: The first is scale ratio, by which the measures of breadth and length are distinguished.
units.literal: The first is scale ratio, by which the measures of breadth and length are distinguished.

units.zh: 二曰准望，所以正彼此之體也。
units.en: The second is orientation and sighting, by which the forms of one place and another are corrected.
units.literal: The second is orientation and sighting, by which the forms of one place and another are corrected.

units.zh: 三曰道里，所以定所由之數也。
units.en: The third is route distance, by which the numbers of the paths taken are fixed.
units.literal: The third is route distance, by which the numbers of the paths taken are fixed.

units.zh: 四曰高下，五曰方邪，六曰迂直，此三者各因地而制宜，所以校夷險之異也。
units.en: The fourth is height and depth, the fifth is square and oblique, and the sixth is winding and straight. These three each adapt their standards according to the terrain and are used to compare differences between level and difficult ground.
units.literal: The fourth is height and depth, the fifth is square and oblique, and the sixth is winding and straight. These three each adapt their standards according to the terrain and are used to compare differences between level and difficult ground.

units.zh: 有圖像而無分率，則無以審遠近之差；
units.en: If there are map images but no scale ratios, there is no way to examine differences in distance.
units.literal: If there are map images but no scale ratios, there is no way to examine differences in distance.

units.zh: 有分率而無准望，雖得之於一隅，必失之于他方；
units.en: If there are scale ratios but no orientation and sighting, even if one gets it right in one corner, one will inevitably lose it in another direction.
units.literal: If there are scale ratios but no orientation and sighting, even if one gets it right in one corner, one will inevitably lose it in another direction.

units.zh: 有准望而無道里，則施於山海絕隔之地，不能以相通；
units.en: If there is orientation and sighting but no route distance, then when it is applied to lands cut off by mountains and seas, they cannot be connected with one another.
units.literal: If there is orientation and sighting but no route distance, then when it is applied to lands cut off by mountains and seas, they cannot be connected with one another.

units.zh: 有道里而無高下、方邪、迂直之校，則徑路之數必與遠近之實相違，失准望之正矣，故以此六者參而考之。
units.en: If there is route distance but no comparison of height and depth, square and oblique, and winding and straight, then the numbers for direct routes will inevitably conflict with the reality of distance and lose the correctness of orientation and sighting. Therefore these six are cross-checked and examined.
units.literal: If there is route distance but no comparison of height and depth, square and oblique, and winding and straight, then the numbers for direct routes will inevitably conflict with the reality of distance and lose the correctness of orientation and sighting. Therefore these six are cross-checked and examined.

units.zh: 然遠近之實定於分率，彼此之實定於道里，度數之實定于高下、方邪、迂直之算。
units.en: Thus the reality of distance is fixed by scale ratios; the reality of one place and another is fixed by route distance; and the reality of measures and numbers is fixed by calculations of height and depth, square and oblique, and winding and straight.
units.literal: Thus the reality of distance is fixed by scale ratios; the reality of one place and another is fixed by route distance; and the reality of measures and numbers is fixed by calculations of height and depth, square and oblique, and winding and straight.

units.zh: 故雖有峻山钜海之隔，絕域殊方之迥，登降詭曲之因，皆可得舉而定者。
units.en: Therefore even where there are barriers of steep mountains and great seas, remoteness of cut-off regions and different quarters, and causes of ascent, descent, irregularity, and curvature, all can be raised and fixed.
units.literal: Therefore even where there are barriers of steep mountains and great seas, remoteness of cut-off regions and different quarters, and causes of ascent, descent, irregularity, and curvature, all can be raised and fixed.

units.zh: 准望之法既正，則曲直遠近無所隱其形也。
units.en: Once the method of orientation and sighting is correct, then winding and straight, far and near have nowhere to hide their forms.
units.literal: Once the method of orientation and sighting is correct, then winding and straight, far and near have nowhere to hide their forms.

units.zh: 秀創制朝儀，廣陳刑政，朝廷多遵用之，以為故事。
units.en: His protocols for audience and criminal policy became the templates the court routinely followed.
units.literal: Xiu framed court ceremonies and expounded penal administration; the court largely adopted his models as standing precedent.

units.zh: 在位四載，為當世名公。
units.en: Across four years at court he stood among the reign's most eminent statesmen.
units.literal: During four years in office he ranked among the celebrated ministers of the age.

units.zh: 服寒食散，當飲熱酒而飲冷酒，泰始七年薨，時年四十八。
units.en: Abusing the cold-food elixir with chilled wine instead of warm killed him in Taishi year seven at forty-eight.
units.literal: He took cold-food powder, which required warm wine, yet drank cold; in the seventh year of Taishi he died, aged forty-eight.

units.zh: 詔曰：「司空經德履哲，體蹈儒雅，佐命翼世，勳業弘茂。
units.en: The throne mourned: "The minister embodied learning and wisdom, shaped the founding enterprise, and built vast achievements.
units.literal: An edict said: "The Minister of Works treads virtue and embraces wisdom; his person embodies Confucian refinement; he aided the Mandate and sustained the age; his merit and enterprise are vast.

units.zh: 方將宣獻敷制，為世宗範，不幸薨殂，朕甚痛之。
units.en: We expected fresh institutions from him; his death leaves us grief-stricken.
units.literal: We had hoped he would proclaim models and spread regulations, to be an exemplar for generations; unluckily he has expired, and We are deeply stricken.

units.zh: 其賜秘器、朝服一具、衣一襲、錢三十萬、布百匹。
units.en: The burial grant included ritual vessels, court dress, a full wardrobe, three hundred thousand coins, and a hundred bolts of silk.
units.literal: Let him be granted mortuary regalia, one full court robe, one suit of clothes, three hundred thousand cash, and one hundred bolts of cloth.

units.zh: 諡曰元。」
units.en: Posthumously he received the epithet Yuan."
units.literal: His posthumous title shall be Yuan."

units.zh: 初，秀以尚書三十六曹統事准例不明，宜使諸卿任職，未及奏而薨。
units.en: He had planned to clarify the thirty-six directorates and devolve power to senior ministers but died before submitting the reform.
units.literal: At first Xiu had held that the thirty-six bureaus of the Department of State Affairs followed unclear precedents and that the chief ministers ought each to bear real duties; before he could memorialize, he died.

units.zh: 其友人料其書記，得表草言平吳之事，其詞曰：「孫皓酷虐，不及聖明禦世兼弱攻昧，使遺子孫，將遂不能臣；
units.en: His friends sorted his writings and found a draft memorial discussing the pacification of Wu. Its words said, "Sun Hao is cruel and tyrannical. If he does not meet a sagely and enlightened ruler who governs the age, annexes the weak, and attacks the benighted, and if descendants are left to him, then in the end he will be unable to become a subject.
units.literal: His friends sorted his writings and found a draft memorial discussing the pacification of Wu. Its words said, "Sun Hao is cruel and tyrannical. If he does not meet a sagely and enlightened ruler who governs the age, annexes the weak, and attacks the benighted, and if descendants are left to him, then in the end he will be unable to become a subject.

units.zh: 時有否泰，非萬安之勢也。
units.en: Times have obstruction and peace; this is not a situation of ten thousandfold security.
units.literal: Times have obstruction and peace; this is not a situation of ten thousandfold security.

units.zh: 臣昔雖已屢言，未有成旨。
units.en: Although I have already spoken repeatedly in the past, there has not yet been a completed decision.
units.literal: Although I have already spoken repeatedly in the past, there has not yet been a completed decision.

units.zh: 今既疾篤不起，謹重屍啟。
units.en: Now my illness is already severe and I will not rise; I respectfully submit this again as a corpse-like memorial.
units.literal: Now my illness is already severe and I will not rise; I respectfully submit this again as a corpse-like memorial.

units.zh: 願陛下時共施用。」
units.en: I hope Your Majesty will put it into use at the proper time together with the other measures."
units.literal: I hope Your Majesty will put it into use at the proper time together with the other measures."

units.zh: 乃封以上聞。
units.en: They forwarded the sealed memorial to the throne.
units.literal: Thereupon they sealed the draft and forwarded it.

units.zh: 詔報曰：「司空薨，痛悼不能去心。
units.en: The emperor answered: "We cannot shake our sorrow at losing the minister.
units.literal: An edict replied: "The Minister of Works has died; Our grief cannot leave Our heart.

units.zh: 又得表草，雖在危困，不忘王室，盡忠憂國。
units.en: His draft shows that even dying he thought only of the dynasty's welfare.
units.literal: Moreover We have obtained the draft memorial; though in mortal danger, he did not forget the royal house and exhausted loyalty in worrying for the state.

units.zh: 省益傷切，輒當與諸賢共論也。」
units.en: Its words wound us anew; we will take counsel with the ministers immediately."
units.literal: Reading it deepens Our wounded grief; We shall discuss it at once with the worthies."

units.zh: 咸甯初，與石苞等並為王公，配享廟庭。
units.en: Early in Xianning he joined Shi Bao and other peers as a spirit recipient in the imperial temple.
units.literal: In the early Xianning era he received paired sacrifice in the ancestral temple alongside Shi Bao and others among the highest nobility.

units.zh: 有二子：浚、頠。
units.en: His sons were Pei Jun and Pei Yi.
units.literal: He had two sons: Jun and Yi.

units.zh: 浚嗣位，至散騎常侍，早卒。
units.en: Jun inherited the fief, rose to supernumerary attendant, and died young.
units.literal: Jun succeeded to the title; he reached Supernumerary Palace Attendant and died young.

units.zh: 浚庶子憬不惠，別封高陽亭侯，以浚少弟頠嗣。=
units.en: Jun's dull-witted son by a concubine, Jing, was separately enfeoffed as Marquis of the Gaoyang village, and Jun's younger brother Yi succeeded to the main line.
units.literal: Jun's bastard son Jing was dull-witted; Jing was separately enfeoffed as Marquis of the Gaoyang village, and Jun's younger brother Yi succeeded to the main line.

units.zh: 子頠
units.en: Pei Yi
units.literal: Yi

units.zh: =頠字逸民。
units.en: Pei Yi, whose courtesy name was Yimin,
units.literal: Yi, courtesy name Yimin.

units.zh: 弘雅有遠識，博學稽古，自少知名。
units.en: Renowned while still young, he combined Classical breadth with long vision.
units.literal: He was magnanimous and refined, with far-reaching insight; broadly learned and versed in antiquity, he was renowned from youth.

units.zh: 御史中丞周弼見而歎曰：「頠若武庫，五兵縱橫，一時之傑也。」
units.en: When Palace Assistant Censor-in-chief Zhou Bi saw him, he sighed and said, "Wei is like an arsenal, with the five weapons crisscrossing; he is an outstanding man of the age."
units.literal: When Palace Assistant Censor-in-chief Zhou Bi saw him, he sighed and said, "Wei is like an arsenal, with the five weapons crisscrossing; he is an outstanding man of the age."

units.zh: 賈充即頠從母夫也，表「秀有佐命之勳，不幸嫡長喪亡，遺孤稚弱。
units.en: Jia Chong was the husband of Wei's mother's sister. He memorialized, "Xiu had merit in assisting the mandate, but unfortunately his legitimate eldest son died and left an orphan young and weak.
units.literal: Jia Chong was the husband of Wei's mother's sister. He memorialized, "Xiu had merit in assisting the mandate, but unfortunately his legitimate eldest son died and left an orphan young and weak.

units.zh: 頠才德英茂，足以興隆國嗣。」
units.en: Wei's talent and virtue are outstanding and flourishing, enough to raise and prosper the state succession."
units.literal: Wei's talent and virtue are outstanding and flourishing, enough to raise and prosper the state succession."

units.zh: 詔頠襲爵，頠固讓，不許。
units.en: An edict ordered Yi to inherit the noble rank; Yi firmly declined, but permission to decline was refused.
units.literal: An edict ordered Yi to inherit the noble rank; Yi firmly declined but permission was refused.

units.zh: 太康二年，徵為太子中庶子，遷散騎常侍。
units.en: Taikang year two brought him tutor of the heir and promotion to supernumerary attendant.
units.literal: In the second year of Taikang he was summoned as Palace Mentor to the heir apparent and promoted to Supernumerary Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 惠帝既位，轉國子祭酒，兼右軍將軍。
units.en: Under Emperor Hui he directed the imperial academy and still led the right guard.
units.literal: When Emperor Hui assumed the throne, Yi was transferred to Libationer of the Imperial Academy while retaining concurrent appointment as General of the Right Guard.

units.zh: 初，頠兄子憬為白衣，頠論述世勳，賜爵高陽亭侯。
units.en: Once cousin Jing wore only commoner's garb, Yi narrated the clan's achievements until the court ennobled Jing at Gaoyang village.
units.literal: At first Yi's nephew Jing was a commoner in white; Yi expounded the family's generations of merit, and Jing was granted the noble rank of Marquis of the Gaoyang village.

units.zh: 楊駿將誅也，駿党左軍將軍劉豫陳兵在門，遇頠，問太傅所在。
units.en: When Yang Jun was about to be executed, Jun's partisan General of the Left Army Liu Yu deployed troops at the gate; he met Yi and asked where the Grand Tutor was.
units.literal: When Yang Jun was about to be executed, Jun's partisan General of the Left Army Liu Yu deployed troops at the gate; he met Yi and asked where the Grand Tutor was.

units.zh: 頠紿之曰：「向於西掖門遇公乘素車，從二人西出矣。」
units.en: Yi lied that he had seen the grand tutor leave west through the Western Lateral Gate in a plain cart.
units.literal: Yi deceived him: "Just now at the Western Portal I met the Duke riding in an unadorned carriage with two followers heading west."

units.zh: 豫曰：「吾何之？」
units.en: Yu asked, "Where shall I go?"
units.literal: Yu said, "Where shall I go?"

units.zh: 頠曰：「宜至廷尉。」
units.en: Surrender to the Ministry of Justice," Yi replied.
units.literal: Yi said, "You ought to report to the Minister of Justice."

units.zh: 豫從頠言，遂委而去。
units.en: Yu obeyed, abandoned his post, and withdrew.
units.literal: Yu followed Yi's words, threw down his arms, and departed.

units.zh: 尋而詔頠代豫領左軍將軍，屯萬春門。
units.en: Yi soon replaced Yu as colonel of the left, camped at Wanchun Gate.
units.literal: Soon an edict ordered Yi to replace Yu and command the Left Army, stationed at Wanchun Gate.

units.zh: 及駿誅，以功當封武昌侯，頠請以封憬，帝竟封頠次子該。
units.en: After Jun's purge Yi earned a Wuchang marquisate but begged to transfer it to Jing; the throne instead ennobled second son Gai.
units.literal: When Jun was executed, Yi merited enfeoffment as Marquis of Wuchang for service; Yi requested the title for Jing, but the emperor in the end enfeoffed Yi's second son Gai.

units.zh: 頠苦陳憬本承嫡，宜襲钜鹿，先帝恩旨，辭不獲命。
units.en: Yi insisted Jing deserved the Julu title per the late emperor's grace yet could not refuse the earlier mandate.
units.literal: Yi bitterly argued that Jing, as heir designate, ought to inherit Julu under the late emperor's decree—he declined but could not escape the command.

units.zh: 武昌之封，己之所蒙，特請以封憬。
units.en: He tried to give his own Wuchang prize to Jing.
units.literal: The Wuchang honor was what he himself had received; he specially requested it be transferred to Jing.

units.zh: 該時尚主，故帝不聽。
units.en: Because Gai had married into the imperial clan, the emperor refused.
units.literal: Gai had by then married a princess, so the emperor did not consent.

units.zh: 累遷侍中。
units.en: He rose again to palace attendant.
units.literal: Yi was repeatedly promoted to Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 時天下暫寧，頠奏修國學，刻石寫經。
units.en: During the lull he urged rebuilding the academy and cutting stone classics.
units.literal: When the realm was briefly at peace, Yi memorialized to restore the imperial academy and carve the classics on stone.

units.zh: 皇太子既講，釋奠祀孔子，飲饗射侯，甚有儀序。
units.en: Once the heir finished lectures, courtiers sacrificed to Confucius, banqueted, and shot at targets with punctilious ritual.
units.literal: After the crown prince had lectured, they performed the grain-offering to Confucius, feasted, and held archery contests—the observances were well ordered.

units.zh: 又令荀籓終父勖之志，鑄鐘鑿磬，以備郊廟朝享禮樂。
units.en: He tasked Xun Fan with casting bells and lithophones for suburban rites and ancestral music, honoring Xun Xu's unfinished plan.
units.literal: He also had Xun Fan fulfill his father Xun Xu's intent, casting bells and chiseling chimes to supply suburban sacrifices, temple offerings, and court music.

units.zh: 頠通博多聞，兼明醫術。
units.en: Besides encyclopedic scholarship he practiced medicine.
units.literal: Yi was broadly learned and well informed, and also understood medicine.

units.zh: 荀勖之修律度也，檢得古尺，短世所用四分有餘。
units.en: Xun Xu's pitch reform uncovered an old foot-rule nearly a quarter shorter than contemporary measures.
units.literal: When Xun Xu revised pitch pipes and measures, inspection recovered an ancient foot shorter than those in current use by more than one fourth.

units.zh: 頠上言：「宜改諸度量。
units.en: "Every balance and yardstick needs reform," he wrote.
units.literal: Yi submitted: "All weights and measures ought to be changed.

units.zh: 若未能悉革，可先改太醫權衡。
units.en: If wholesale change is impossible, start with the imperial dispensary's weights.
units.literal: If they cannot all be reformed at once, begin by changing the scales for the Imperial Pharmacy.

units.zh: 此若差違，遂失神農、岐伯之正。
units.en: Wrong measures betray Shennong and Qi Bo's pharmacological norms.
units.literal: If these miss the standard, one loses the correct measures of Shennong and Qi Bo.

units.zh: 藥物輕重，分兩乖互，所可傷夭，為害尤深。
units.en: Inconsistent dosages kill patients.
units.literal: When drugs vary in weight and portions contradict each other, the harm to life can be especially grave.

units.zh: 古壽考而今短折者，未必不由此也。」
units.en: Perhaps shorter modern lifespans stem from exactly these errors."
units.literal: That antiquity enjoyed long life while today people die young is not necessarily unrelated to this."

units.zh: 卒不能用。
units.en: The court ignored him.
units.literal: In the end [his advice] was not adopted.

units.zh: 樂廣嘗與頠清言，欲以理服之，而頠辭論豐博，廣笑而不言。
units.en: Yue Guang tried to win a xuanxue debate yet yielded silently before Yi's torrent.
units.literal: Yue Guang once engaged Yi in pure conversation, intending to prevail by logic, but Yi's discourse was rich and ample; Guang smiled and said nothing.

units.zh: 時人謂頠為言談之林藪。
units.en: Contemporaries dubbed him the wilderness where discourse gathered.
units.literal: People of the time called Yi the forest and marsh of conversation.

units.zh: 頠以賈后不悅太子，抗表請增崇太子所生謝淑妃位號，仍啟增置後衛率吏，給三千兵，於是東宮宿衛萬人。
units.en: To shield Crown Prince Yu against Empress Jia's spite, Yi demanded higher honors for Lady Xie and three thousand extra rear-guard troops, swelling the heir's garrison to ten thousand.
units.literal: Because Empress Jia disliked the crown prince, Yi submitted a blunt memorial asking to elevate the rank title of Consort Xie who bore the heir, and further requested adding rear-guard officers for the heir's household with three thousand troops—thereupon the Eastern Palace household guards numbered ten thousand.

units.zh: 遷尚書，侍中如故，加光祿大夫。
units.en: He moved up to minister of state, kept his attendant post, and gained the household grandee title.
units.literal: He was promoted to Director of the Department of State Affairs, kept Palace Attendant as before, with additional title Household Grandee.

units.zh: 每授一職，未嘗不殷勤固讓，表疏十餘上，博引古今成敗以為言，覽之者莫不寒心。
units.en: Every promotion drew stacks of refusal memorials stuffed with historical warnings that chilled every reader.
units.literal: Each time he received an appointment he invariably declined earnestly; his memorials ran to more than ten submissions, citing successes and failures from antiquity to the present—those who read them felt chill in the heart.

units.zh: 頠深慮賈后亂政，與司空張華、侍中賈模議廢之而立謝淑妃。
units.en: Fearing Jia Nanfeng's misrule, he plotted with Zhang Hua and Jia Mo to replace her with Lady Xie.
units.literal: Yi deeply feared Empress Jia would disorder the government; together with Minister of Works Zhang Hua and Palace Attendant Jia Mo he discussed deposing her and enthroning Consort Xie.

units.zh: 華、模皆曰：「帝自無廢黜之意，若吾等專行之，上心不以為是。
units.en: "The emperor never meant to depose her," Zhang and Jia replied; acting alone would anger him.
units.literal: Hua and Mo both said: "The emperor himself has no intent to dismiss her; if we act alone in this, in his heart he will not approve.

units.zh: 且諸王方剛，朋黨異議，恐禍如發機，身死國危，無益社稷。」
units.en: The martial princes split into factions; forcing the issue might spring a trap that kills us without saving the realm."
units.literal: Moreover the princes are just now forceful; factions argue differently—we fear disaster would strike like a spring-trigger—our deaths and the state's peril would benefit the altars not at all."

units.zh: 頠曰：「誠如公慮。
units.en: True enough," Yi conceded.
units.literal: Yi said: "Truly it is as you fear.

units.zh: 但昏虐之人，無所忌憚，亂可立待，將如之何？」
units.en: Yet a reckless tyrant invites instant chaos—what then?"
units.literal: Yet a benighted and cruel person fears nothing; chaos can arrive at once—what then are we to do?"

units.zh: 華曰：「卿二人猶且見信，然勤為左右陳禍福之戒，冀無大悖。
units.en: Stay close and lecture him on fortune and ruin," Zhang urged.
units.literal: Hua said: "You two are still trusted; diligently instruct him left and right on the consequences of fortune and disaster, and perhaps there will be no great rebellion.

units.zh: 幸天下尚安，庶可優遊卒歲。」
units.en: While peace lasts we might survive."
units.literal: Fortunately the realm is still calm; perhaps we can drift through our years."

units.zh: 此謀遂寢。
units.en: They dropped the plot.
units.literal: This plan then was abandoned.

units.zh: 頠旦夕勸說從母廣城君，令戒喻賈后親待太子而已。
units.en: Yi besought Aunt Guangcheng daily to teach Nanfeng to honor the heir.
units.literal: Morning and evening Yi urged his maternal aunt the Lady of Guangcheng to instruct Empress Jia to cherish the heir apparent.

units.zh: 或說頠曰：「幸與中宮內外可得盡言。
units.en: Someone advised Wei, "Fortunately, with those inside and outside the central palace, you can speak fully.
units.literal: Someone advised Wei, "Fortunately, with those inside and outside the central palace, you can speak fully.

units.zh: 言若不行，則可辭病摒退。
units.en: If ignored, resign on grounds of illness.
units.literal: If your words do not prevail, you may plead illness and withdraw.

units.zh: 若二者不立，雖有十表，難乎免矣。」
units.en: Otherwise ten memorials will not spare you."
units.literal: If neither course can be established, though you submit ten memorials, escape will be hard."

units.zh: 頠慨然久之，而竟不能行。
units.en: Yi brooded yet never acted.
units.literal: Yi sighed deeply for a long time but in the end could not act.

units.zh: 遷尚書左僕射，侍中如故。
units.en: He became senior minister of the left while remaining attendant.
units.literal: He was promoted to Senior Minister of the Left of the Department of State Affairs, Palace Attendant as before.

units.zh: 頠雖後之親屬，然雅望素隆，四海不謂之以親戚進也，惟恐其不居位。
units.en: Despite ties to Nanfeng, his prestige rested on merit; the realm dreaded losing him, not nepotism.
units.literal: Though Yi was kin to the empress, his lofty reputation had long stood—none under heaven thought he had risen through kinship; they only feared he might leave office.

units.zh: 俄復使頠專任門下事，固讓，不聽。
units.en: The court tried to leave the entire Chancellery to him; refusals went unheard.
units.literal: Soon he was again assigned sole charge of Chancellery affairs; he firmly declined and was not heard.

units.zh: 頠上言：「賈模適亡，復以臣代，崇外戚之望，彰偏私之舉。
units.en: "Replacing Jia Mo with me," he warned, "spotlights consort power.
units.literal: Yi memorialized: "Jia Mo has just died; again substituting me increases expectation toward outside kin and displays partial favor.

units.zh: 後族何常有能自保，皆知重親無脫者也。
units.en: No maternal house survives forever by leaning on blood ties.
units.literal: When has a maternal clan ever been able to protect itself? All know that leaning on kinship brings no escape.

units.zh: 然漢二十四帝惟孝文、光武、明帝不重外戚，皆保其宗，豈將獨賢，實以安理故也。
units.en: Only Han Wen, Guangwu, and Ming avoided nepotism—and kept their dynasties secure.
units.literal: Yet among the twenty-four Han emperors only Wen, Guangwu, and Ming did not favor maternal relatives—all preserved their houses; were they uniquely worthy? Truly they acted by principles that kept peace.

units.zh: 昔穆叔不拜越禮之饗，臣亦不敢聞殊常之詔。」
units.en: Like Shu Zhao rejecting improper feasts, I cannot obey irregular favors."
units.literal: Once Uncle Mu declined a feast that breached ritual; your servant too does not dare hear an extraordinary edict."

units.zh: 又表云：「咎繇謨虞，伊尹相商，呂望翊周，蕭張佐漢，咸播功化，光格四極。
units.en: He also memorialized, "Gao Yao counseled Yu, Yi Yin served as minister to Shang, Lu Wang aided Zhou, and Xiao He and Zhang Liang assisted Han; all spread merit and transformation, and their radiance reached the four extremes.
units.literal: He also memorialized, "Gao Yao counseled Yu, Yi Yin served as minister to Shang, Lu Wang aided Zhou, and Xiao He and Zhang Liang assisted Han; all spread merit and transformation, and their radiance reached the four extremes.

units.zh: 暨于繼體，咎單、傅說，祖己、樊仲，亦隆中興。
units.en: Lesser heirs too relied on Gu Dan, Fu Yue, Zu Yi, and Fan Zhong during revivals.
units.literal: At the succession of heirs, Gu Dan, Fu Yue, Zu Yi, Fan Zhong likewise prospered mid-restoration.

units.zh: 或明揚側陋，或起自庶族，豈非尚德之舉，以臻斯美哉！
units.en: Elevating talent over pedigree produced golden ages.
units.literal: Some were promoted from humble obscurity, some rose from common clans—were these not deeds that honored virtue and attained such beauty!

units.zh: 曆觀近世，不能慕遠，溺於近情，多任後親，以致不靜。
units.en: Later courts chased sentiment and stuffed offices with in-laws—hence chaos.
units.literal: Looking over recent ages, rulers could not emulate antiquity and drowned in private feeling; most entrusted maternal kin, hence unrest.

units.zh: 昔疏廣戒太子以舅氏為官屬，前世以為知禮。
units.en: Shu Guang once forbade crown-prince posts for maternal uncles—praised as ritual correctness.
units.literal: Once Shu Guang warned the crown prince against taking maternal uncles as household officers—the former age deemed that knowing ritual.

units.zh: 況朝廷何取于外戚，正復才均，尚當先其疏者，以明至公。
units.en: Even when talent matches, prefer distant kin to prove impartiality.
units.literal: How much less should the court favor maternal relatives—when talents are even, one ought still to prefer the more distant, to manifest utmost fairness.

units.zh: 漢世不用馮野王，即其事也。」
units.en: The Han age did not employ Feng Yewang; this is that matter."
units.literal: The Han age did not employ Feng Yewang; this is that matter."

units.zh: 表上，皆優詔敦譬。
units.en: Each memorial drew soothing replies begging him to stay.
units.literal: When the memorials went up, each received kindly edicts urging him to yield.

units.zh: 時以陳准子匡、韓蔚子嵩並侍東宮，頠諫曰：「東宮之建，以儲皇極。
units.en: At the time, Chen Zhun's son Kuang and Han Wei's son Song were both serving in the Eastern Palace. Wei remonstrated, saying, "The Eastern Palace is established to uphold the heir as the imperial pole.
units.literal: At the time, Chen Zhun's son Kuang and Han Wei's son Song were both serving in the Eastern Palace. Wei remonstrated, saying, "The establishment of the Eastern Palace is to store up the imperial standard.

units.zh: 其所與遊接，必簡英俊，宜用成德。
units.en: Its companions must be seasoned worthies.
units.literal: Those who lodge and associate there must be chosen from the talented and heroic; men of completed virtue should serve.

units.zh: 匡、嵩幼弱，未識人理立身之節。
units.en: Kuang and Song were mere boys ignorant of duty.
units.literal: Kuang and Song are young and weak and do not grasp the norms of conduct.

units.zh: 東宮實體夙成之表，而今有童子侍從之聲，未是光闡遐風之弘理也。」
units.en: The Eastern Palace is in substance the sign of early maturity, but now there is the sound of children attending there; this is not the broad principle by which to make distant custom shine forth."
units.literal: The Eastern Palace is in substance the sign of early maturity, but now there is the sound of children attending there; this is not the broad principle by which to make distant custom shine forth."

units.zh: 湣懷太子之廢也，頠與張華苦爭不從，語在《華傳》。
units.en: Yi and Zhang Hua fought bitterly against Minhuai's removal—the fuller story sits in Zhang's biography.
units.literal: When Crown Prince Minhuai was deposed, Yi with Zhang Hua bitterly disputed but was not heeded—the account is in Hua's biography.

units.zh: 頠深患時俗放蕩，不尊儒術，何晏、阮籍素有高名於世，口談浮虛，不遵禮法，屍祿耽寵，仕不事事；
units.en: Pei Wei deeply worried that the age's unrestrained customs did not honor Confucian teaching. He Yan and Ruan Ji enjoyed lofty reputations, talking idle emptiness and ignoring ritual law, drawing salary and indulging favor while holding office yet doing nothing.
units.literal: Pei Wei deeply worried that the customs of the age were unrestrained and did not honor Confucian teaching; He Yan and Ruan Ji enjoyed lofty reputations in the world, talking idle emptiness at the mouth and not observing ritual law—drawing salary and indulging favor while holding office yet doing nothing.

units.zh: 至王衍之徒，聲譽太盛，位高勢重，不以物務自嬰，遂相放效，風教陵遲，乃著崇有之論以釋其蔽曰：夫總混群本，宗極之道也。
units.en: When it came to Wang Yan and his followers, their reputations were too great and their positions high and powerful, yet they did not entangle themselves in practical affairs. They then imitated one another, and custom and teaching declined. Pei Wei therefore wrote the Treatise on Honoring Being to explain this harm, saying: Gathering and blending the many roots is the Way that honors the ultimate.
units.literal: When it came to Wang Yan and his followers, their reputations were too great and their positions high and powerful, yet they did not entangle themselves in practical affairs. They then imitated one another, and custom and teaching declined. Pei Wei therefore wrote the Treatise on Honoring Being to explain this harm, saying: Gathering and blending the many roots is the Way that honors the ultimate.

units.zh: 方以族異，庶類之品也。
units.en: Being square or regular differs according to kind; this is the ordering of the many classes.
units.literal: Being square or regular differs according to kind; this is the ordering of the many classes.

units.zh: 形象著分，有生之體也。
units.en: Forms and appearances display distinctions; this is the substance of what has life.
units.literal: Forms and appearances display distinctions; this is the substance of what has life.

units.zh: 化感錯綜，理跡之原也。
units.en: Transformation and response are interwoven; this is the source of the traces of principle.
units.literal: Transformation and response are interwoven; this is the source of the traces of principle.

units.zh: 夫品而為族，則所稟者偏，偏無自足，故憑乎外資。
units.en: When things are ordered into classes and become kinds, what each receives is partial. What is partial cannot suffice by itself, and therefore depends on external resources.
units.literal: When things are ordered into classes and become kinds, what each receives is partial. What is partial cannot suffice by itself, and therefore depends on external resources.

units.zh: 是以生而可尋，所謂理也。
units.en: Thus what can be traced in life is what is called principle.
units.literal: Thus what can be traced in life is what is called principle.

units.zh: 理之所體，所謂有也。
units.en: What principle embodies is what is called being.
units.literal: What principle embodies is what is called being.

units.zh: 有之所須，所謂資也。
units.en: What being requires is what is called resource.
units.literal: What being requires is what is called resource.

units.zh: 資有攸合，所謂宜也。
units.en: When resources have what they fit, this is what is called appropriateness.
units.literal: When resources have what they fit, this is what is called appropriateness.

units.zh: 擇乎厥宜，所謂情也。
units.en: Choosing according to that appropriateness is what is called feeling or disposition.
units.literal: Choosing according to that appropriateness is what is called feeling or disposition.

units.zh: 識智既授，雖出處異業，默語殊塗，所以寶生存宜，其情一也。
units.en: Once perception and intelligence have been granted, even if withdrawal and service are different activities and silence and speech are different paths, the reason one values life and preserves what is appropriate is one in disposition.
units.literal: Once perception and intelligence have been granted, even if withdrawal and service are different activities and silence and speech are different paths, the reason one values life and preserves what is appropriate is one in disposition.

units.zh: 眾理並而無害，故貴賤形焉。
units.en: The many principles coexist without harming one another, and therefore noble and base take shape.
units.literal: The many principles coexist without harming one another, and therefore noble and base take shape.

units.zh: 失得由乎所接，故吉凶兆焉。
units.en: Loss and gain arise from what one engages, and therefore good and bad fortune show their signs.
units.literal: Loss and gain arise from what one engages, and therefore good and bad fortune show their signs.

units.zh: 是以賢人君子，知欲不可絕，而交物有會。
units.en: Therefore worthy men and gentlemen know that desires cannot be cut off, and that engagement with things has its proper meeting point.
units.literal: Therefore worthy men and gentlemen know that desires cannot be cut off, and that engagement with things has its proper meeting point.

units.zh: 觀乎往復，稽中定務。
units.en: They observe going and returning, examine the mean, and settle affairs.
units.literal: They observe going and returning, examine the mean, and settle affairs.

units.zh: 惟夫用天之道，分地之利，躬其力任，勞而後饗。
units.en: Only by using the Way of Heaven, dividing the benefits of Earth, personally taking up one's strength and responsibilities, and laboring before enjoying can things be done.
units.literal: Only by using the Way of Heaven, dividing the benefits of Earth, personally taking up one's strength and responsibilities, and laboring before enjoying can things be done.

units.zh: 居以仁順，守以恭儉，率以忠信，行以敬讓，志無盈求，事無過用，乃可濟乎！
units.en: Dwell in humaneness and compliance, keep to reverence and frugality, lead with loyalty and trustworthiness, act with respect and yielding, let the will have no overflowing demands, and let affairs have no excessive use; only then can one succeed.
units.literal: Dwell in humaneness and compliance, keep to reverence and frugality, lead with loyalty and trustworthiness, act with respect and yielding, let the will have no overflowing demands, and let affairs have no excessive use; only then can one succeed.

units.zh: 故大建厥極，綏理群生，訓物垂範，於是乎在，斯則聖人為政之由也。
units.en: Thus greatly establishing the standard, pacifying and ordering the multitude of living beings, instructing things and leaving models depend on this; this is the route by which the sages carried out government.
units.literal: Thus greatly establishing the standard, pacifying and ordering the multitude of living beings, instructing things and leaving models depend on this; this is the route by which the sages carried out government.

units.zh: 若乃淫抗陵肆，則危害萌矣。
units.en: If, however, excess, resistance, arrogance, and unrestrained conduct arise, danger and harm begin to sprout.
units.literal: If, however, excess, resistance, arrogance, and unrestrained conduct arise, danger and harm begin to sprout.

units.zh: 故欲衍則速患，情佚則怨博，擅恣則興攻，專利則延寇，可謂以厚生而失生者也。
units.en: Thus when desire spreads it hastens trouble; when feeling is indulgent resentments broaden; when one acts arbitrarily and willfully attacks arise; when one monopolizes benefit bandits are invited. This may be called losing life while trying to enrich life.
units.literal: Thus when desire spreads it hastens trouble; when feeling is indulgent resentments broaden; when one acts arbitrarily and willfully attacks arise; when one monopolizes benefit bandits are invited. This may be called losing life while trying to enrich life.

units.zh: 悠悠之徒，駭乎若茲之釁，而尋艱爭所緣。
units.en: The drifting sort of people were startled by troubles like these and sought out the causes from which hardship and contention arose.
units.literal: The drifting sort of people were startled by troubles like these and sought out the causes from which hardship and contention arose.

units.zh: 察夫偏質有弊，而睹簡損之善，遂闡貴無之議，而建賤有之論。
units.en: They observed that partial substance has defects, and saw the good in simplicity and reduction; they then expounded the doctrine that honors nonbeing and established the argument that devalues being.
units.literal: They observed that partial substance has defects, and saw the good in simplicity and reduction; they then expounded the doctrine that honors nonbeing and established the argument that devalues being.

units.zh: 賤有則必外形，外形則必遺制，遺制則必忽防，忽防則必忘禮。
units.en: If being is devalued, then form must be externalized; if form is externalized, then institutions must be abandoned; if institutions are abandoned, then safeguards must be neglected; if safeguards are neglected, then ritual must be forgotten.
units.literal: If being is devalued, then form must be externalized; if form is externalized, then institutions must be abandoned; if institutions are abandoned, then safeguards must be neglected; if safeguards are neglected, then ritual must be forgotten.

units.zh: 禮制弗存，則無以為政矣。
units.en: If ritual institutions do not remain, there is nothing by which to govern.
units.literal: If ritual institutions do not remain, there is nothing by which to govern.

units.zh: 眾之從上，猶水之居器也。
units.en: The multitude following those above is like water occupying a vessel.
units.literal: The multitude following those above is like water occupying a vessel.

units.zh: 故兆庶之情，信于所習；
units.en: Therefore the feelings of the common people trust in what they are accustomed to.
units.literal: Therefore the feelings of the common people trust in what they are accustomed to.

units.zh: 習則心服其業，業服則謂之理然。
units.en: Once accustomed, their minds submit to their tasks; when their tasks are accepted, they call it naturally right.
units.literal: Once accustomed, their minds submit to their tasks; when their tasks are accepted, they call it naturally right.

units.zh: 是以君人必慎所教，班其政刑一切之務，分宅百姓，各授四職，能令稟命之者不肅而安，忽然忘異，莫有遷志。
units.en: Therefore one who rules people must be careful about what he teaches, distributes all the affairs of government and punishments, divides dwellings among the hundred surnames, and assigns each of the four occupations. He can make those who receive commands be at ease without sternness, suddenly forget differences, and have no mind to shift.
units.literal: Therefore one who rules people must be careful about what he teaches, distributes all the affairs of government and punishments, divides dwellings among the hundred surnames, and assigns each of the four occupations. He can make those who receive commands be at ease without sternness, suddenly forget differences, and have no mind to shift.

units.zh: 況於據在三之尊，懷所隆之情，敦以為訓者哉！
units.en: How much more is this true for one who occupies the honor of the three (ruler, father, and teacher), holds feelings about what should be exalted, and treats them seriously as instruction.
units.literal: How much more is this true for one who occupies the honor of the three (ruler, father, and teacher), holds feelings about what should be exalted, and treats them seriously as instruction.

units.zh: 斯乃昏明所階，不可不審。
units.en: This is the step by which darkness or clarity proceeds, and it must be examined carefully.
units.literal: This is the step by which darkness or clarity proceeds, and it must be examined carefully.

units.zh: 夫盈欲可損而未可絕有也，過用可節而未可謂無貴也。
units.en: Overflowing desire may be reduced, but being cannot be cut off; excessive use may be regulated, but it cannot be said that there is nothing valuable.
units.literal: Overflowing desire may be reduced, but being cannot be cut off; excessive use may be regulated, but it cannot be said that there is nothing valuable.

units.zh: 蓋有講言之具者，深列有形之故，盛稱空無之美。
units.en: Those equipped for discourse deeply arrayed the causes of what has form and grandly praised the beauty of emptiness and nonbeing.
units.literal: Those equipped for discourse deeply arrayed the causes of what has form and grandly praised the beauty of emptiness and nonbeing.

units.zh: 形器之故有征，空無之義難檢，辯巧之文可悅，似象之言足惑，眾聽眩焉，溺其成說。
units.en: The causes of forms and vessels have evidence; the meaning of emptiness and nonbeing is hard to check. Cleverly argued writings can delight, and words resembling images are enough to confuse, so the many listeners were dazzled and drowned in these completed doctrines.
units.literal: The causes of forms and vessels have evidence; the meaning of emptiness and nonbeing is hard to check. Cleverly argued writings can delight, and words resembling images are enough to confuse, so the many listeners were dazzled and drowned in these completed doctrines.

units.zh: 雖頗有異此心者，辭不獲濟，屈於所狎，因謂虛無之理，誠不可蓋。
units.en: Although some had minds that differed from this, their words could not prevail; they yielded to what was familiar, and accordingly said that the principle of emptiness and nonbeing truly could not be covered over.
units.literal: Although some had minds that differed from this, their words could not prevail; they yielded to what was familiar, and accordingly said that the principle of emptiness and nonbeing truly could not be covered over.

units.zh: 唱而有和，多往弗反，遂薄綜世之務，賤功烈之用，高浮游之業，埤經實之賢。
units.en: When one sang out, others harmonized; many went forth and did not return. They then slighted the work of managing the age, devalued the use of achievements, elevated the occupation of drifting idly, and lowered worthies of canonical substance.
units.literal: When one sang out, others harmonized; many went forth and did not return. They then slighted the work of managing the age, devalued the use of achievements, elevated the occupation of drifting idly, and lowered worthies of canonical substance.

units.zh: 人情所殉，篤夫名利。
units.en: What human feelings die for is especially name and profit.
units.literal: What human feelings die for is especially name and profit.

units.zh: 於是文者衍其辭，訥者贊其旨，染其眾也。
units.en: Thereupon those skilled in writing elaborated their words, and those slow of speech praised their intent, staining the multitude with it.
units.literal: Thereupon those skilled in writing elaborated their words, and those slow of speech praised their intent, staining the multitude with it.

units.zh: 是以立言藉於虛無，謂之玄妙；
units.en: Thus setting up words by relying on emptiness and nonbeing was called mysterious subtlety.
units.literal: Thus setting up words by relying on emptiness and nonbeing was called mysterious subtlety.

units.zh: 處官不親所司，謂之雅遠；
units.en: Holding office without personally attending to one's responsibilities was called elegant remoteness.
units.literal: Holding office without personally attending to one's responsibilities was called elegant remoteness.

units.zh: 奉身散其廉操，謂之曠達。
units.en: Supporting oneself while scattering one's integrity and conduct was called broad-minded freedom.
units.literal: Supporting oneself while scattering one's integrity and conduct was called broad-minded freedom.

units.zh: 故砥礪之風，彌以陵遲。
units.en: Therefore the custom of whetting and disciplining oneself declined all the more.
units.literal: Therefore the custom of whetting and disciplining oneself declined all the more.

units.zh: 放者因斯，或悖吉凶之禮，而忽容止之表，瀆棄長幼之序，混漫貴賤之級。
